description: Image Description: The image depicts an outdoor urban scene featuring a set of concrete stairs with black metal railings on the left side. A bright turquoise umbrella lies on its side on the paved ground near the base of the stairs, casting a distinct shadow due to sunlight. The umbrella appears to be open but not in use. To the right of the umbrella, there is a low concrete planter
